{"step":2,"file":"options.c","function":"fio_options_parse","line":5195,"var":"opts_copy","code":"opts_copy = dup_and_sub_options(opts, num_opts);","note":"Before normal parsing, fio duplicates each option string and performs variable and keyword substitution on the copy."},
{"step":3,"file":"options.c","function":"dup_and_sub_options","line":5150,"var":"opts_copy[i]","code":"opts_copy[i] = fio_keyword_replace(opts_copy[i]);","note":"The copied option description=$ncpus is passed to keyword substitution."},
{"step":4,"file":"options.c","function":"fio_keyword_replace","line":5098,"var":"s","code":"while ((s = strstr(opt, kw->word)) != NULL) {","note":"The function locates the $ncpus keyword inside the option string and prepares to rewrite it in place."},
{"step":5,"file":"options.c","function":"fio_keyword_replace","line":5100,"var":"new","code":"char *new = calloc(strlen(opt) + 1, 1);","note":"A fresh heap buffer is allocated for the rewritten string."},
{"step":6,"file":"options.c","function":"fio_keyword_replace","line":5112,"var":"opt","code":"opt += strlen(kw->word) + olen;","note":"The code advances opt past the keyword, so opt no longer points to the original allocation start."},
{"step":7,"file":"options.c","function":"fio_keyword_replace","line":5120,"var":"o_org","code":"free(o_org);","note":"The original allocation is freed, but the later code still uses the advanced opt pointer to compute lengths and copy the tail, creating the heap overrun condition when the keyword is present in the job file."}
]
open('/workspace/candidate_trace.json','w').write(json.dumps(trace))
